chapter: Charlie Johnson, Willie Gant and the late 1920s
title: The spelling of Caldwell
summary: His name was sometimes spelled with a u; teachers misspelled it.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well now, where did we get? Yes, your name used to be spelled with a U at one time, didn't it? C-a-u-l-d

That's French version, C-u-l-d. I had a lot of time when I was a kid in grammar school. The teachers would misspell it. Some would spell it C-a-l-d-w-e-l-l, C-a-u-l-d-w-e-l-l, but it's C-a-l-d-w-e-l-l.
Yeah. Well, actually, of course, it is spelled both ways.
